titles.title: Purple Petunias

description: Two large, abstract purple petunias with green centers fill the frame. Their petals are dark purple, but glow pale pink shade where they reflect an unseen light source. At the top of the composition, small fragments of a plain white background are visible.
imageCaption: Courtesy of Newark Museum of Art.
title: Purple Petunias
